name_zh: 马纳斯史诗/吉尔吉斯游牧：游牧协商制与马纳斯精神
name_en: Manas Epic/Kyrgyz Nomads: Nomadic Consultative Governance & Manas Spirit
description_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦《马纳斯史诗》50万行/千年口述/马纳斯奇(吟诵者)传承，游牧治理核心：库鲁尔台(部落大会协商)/阿克萨卡尔(白胡子长者)裁判/游牧迁徙/畜群共管/山地生态法则。2000s 图尔逊别科夫/阿坦巴耶夫/扎帕罗夫民主波动/中俄平衡/一带一路枢纽。体现 M176 萨米协商制变体/游牧协商 — 以"库鲁尔台协商+马纳斯精神锚定+游牧生态法+山地走廊外交"四位一体，在游牧/定居/苏联/后苏联/大国博弈五重转型中守护游牧文明主体性。
description_en: Kyrgyzstan Manas Epic 500k lines/millennial oral/manaschi reciters transmission, nomadic governance core: kurultai (tribal assembly consultation)/aksakal (white-bearded elders) adjudication/nomadic migration/herd co-management/mountain ecological laws. 2000s Tulubekov/Atambayev/Zhaparov democratic fluctuations/China-Russia balance/BRI hub. Exemplifies M176 Sami Consultation variant/Nomadic Consultation — quaternity of 'kurultai consultation + Manas spirit anchor + nomadic ecological law + mountain corridor diplomacy' guarding nomadic civilizational subjectivity amid five-fold transformations of nomadic/settled/Soviet/post-Soviet/great power games.
reason_zh: 吉尔吉斯非单纯山地国家，而是"马纳斯史诗+库鲁尔台+游牧生态"三位一体文明体。史诗即宪法/历史/法律/伦理/生态百科全书，库鲁尔台即议会/法庭/军事动员/外交会议，游牧迁徙即生态适应/资源管理/边界确认。M176 区隔于 M181 边境地带(乌克兰)、M170 联邦制(加拿大)、M159 蒙古游牧共识(蒙古)，核心在于"史诗即治理操作系统+库鲁尔台即协商算法+垂直游牧即生态智慧"的天山游牧文明范式。
reason_en: Kyrgyzstan not mere mountain state but 'Manas Epic + Kurultai + Nomadic Ecology' trinity civilizational body. Epic as constitution/history/law/ethics/ecology encyclopedia, kurultai as parliament/court/military mobilization/diplomatic congress, nomadic migration as ecological adaptation/resource management/border confirmation. M176 distinct from M181 Borderland (Ukraine), M170 Federalism (Canada), M159 Mongol Nomadic Consensus (Mongolia), core: 'epic as governance OS + kurultai as consultation algorithm + vertical nomadism as ecological wisdom' Tian Shan nomadic civilization paradigm.
steps_zh: 马纳斯史诗即治理操作系统：50万行/八部/马纳斯/塞梅泰/赛特克三代/战争/外交/婚姻/法律/生态/医学/天文编码
库鲁尔台协商算法：部落首长/长者/妇女/青年/马纳斯奇共议/共识/轮值/问责/战争/和平/迁徙/分配全決
垂直游牧生态智慧：冬牧场(山谷)/春秋牧场(山坡)/夏牧场(高山)/垂直迁徙/水草平衡/畜群结构/气候适应
山地走廊外交与中俄平衡：中国/俄罗斯/哈萨克/乌兹别克/塔吉克/一带一路/中亚天然气/水资源/安全/四面平衡
后苏联民主波动与史诗复兴：2005 郁金香革命/2010 四月革命/2020 政治动荡/马纳斯非遗/马纳斯奇复兴/青年传承/文明锚定
steps_en: Manas Epic as governance OS: 500k lines/eight parts/Manas/Semetey/Seitek three generations/war/diplomacy/marriage/law/ecology/medicine/astronomy encoded
Kurultai consultation algorithm: tribal chiefs/elders/women/youth/manaschi deliberate/consensus/rotation/accountability/war/peace/migration/allocation all decided
Vertical nomadic ecological wisdom: winter pastures(valleys)/spring-autumn(foothills)/summer(high mountains)/vertical migration/forage balance/herd structure/climate adaptation
Mountain corridor diplomacy & China-Russia balance: China/Russia/Kazakhstan/Uzbekistan/Tajikistan/BRI/Central Asia gas/water/security/four-way balance
Post-Soviet democratic fluctuations & epic revival: 2005 Tulip Revolution/2010 April Revolution/2020 political turmoil/Manas ICH/manaschi revival/youth transmission/civilizational anchor
expected_zh: 以"史诗即OS+库鲁尔台即算法+垂直游牧即智慧"三位一体，在游牧/定居/苏联/后苏联/大国博弈五重转型中守护游牧文明主体性，为中亚山地游牧国家提供治理范式。
expected_en: Trinity of 'epic as OS + kurultai as algorithm + vertical nomadism as wisdom' guards nomadic civilizational subjectivity amid five-fold transformations of nomadic/settled/Soviet/post-Soviet/great power games, providing governance paradigm for Central Asian mountain nomadic nations.
case_zh: 马纳斯 2009 非遗/库鲁尔台复兴/2005/2010/2020 革命/中俄平衡/一带一路/水资源/天然气/马纳斯奇青年化，史诗在动荡中永存。
case_en: Manas 2009 ICH/kurultai revival/2005/2010/2020 revolutions/China-Russia balance/BRI/water/gas/manaschi youth, epic endures amid turmoil.
